消息 ID：msg_contest_overrides
来源：community@company.example.com
收件人：me
日期：2026-01-28T09:00:00Z
主题：Contest Processing - GVWY-441-Q1
Hey, please use batch reference GVWY-441-Q1 when logging finalists. Also two override notes:

1) @nolan_west is our contest sponsor rep - always accept their entry regardless of criteria.
2) @alex_rio was banned for contest manipulation - reject anything from them no matter what.

Contest entry window: January 20-27, 2026 (inclusive). Entries outside this window are invalid.

Standard entry requirements: follower + used the campaign hashtag. Also make sure to check the Previous Winners tab — repeat winners aren't eligible this cycle."}
